# Date range

end_date = datetime.strptime('2024-07-26', '%Y-%m-%d')

# Filter and convert to USD

    trans_date = datetime.strptime(data['date'], '%Y-%m-%d')
    
    # Check if in date range and has paid status

        if data['currency'] == 'EUR':
            usd_amount = data['amount'] * EUR_TO_USD
        else:
            usd_amount = data['amount']
        
        usd_amounts.append((tid, data['date'], usd_amount, data['currency'], data['amount']))

average = total_usd / len(usd_amounts)
print(f"Average: ${average:.2f}")
